name: SPDR Gold Shares (Ondo Tokenized)
oneLiner: GLDON is Ondo’s NAV-style SPDR Gold Shares tracker, redeemable by eligible investors through issuer stablecoin rails without ETF delivery rights.
collateral: SPDR Gold Shares (GLD) ETF exposure and cash in transit held for Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited; tokenholders hold a debt-security claim rather than direct ETF shares.
pegMechanism: Total-return tracker of SPDR Gold Shares with issuer-calculated NAV and eligible-investor subscription/redemption. Ordinary redemption is to USDon; conversion to USDC depends on stablecoin-swapper liquidity. No fixed $1 peg or physical-gold redemption.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The March 26, 2026 GLDon Final Terms bind the Ethereum token 0x423d42e505e64f99b6e277eb7ed324cc5606f139 to a debt instrument tracking SPDR Gold Shares. Ondo identifies native Ethereum, BNB and Solana issuance and bridged HyperEVM. This fund-security tracker belongs to the same rwa-credit-fund investment surface as IAUon and SLVon, not direct allocated gold.

proofOfReserves.provider: Ankura Trust Company. Retrieved September 23, 2026 daily report reconciles aggregate Ondo Stocks, USDY and USDon assets and obligations; it does not identify GLDON-specific GLD shares, cash or liabilities. Aggregate reference evidence does not establish exact-token financial assurance.

notices.title: Tokenized ETF exposure
notices.message: GLDON provides economic exposure to SPDR Gold Shares. Holders have no right to receive ETF shares or physical gold; investor eligibility and issuer redemption restrictions apply.
